verdict: NOT YET MEASURABLE - the observation window is too short. Lead time and false-positive rate cannot be honestly reported until at least three weeks of history exist.

lead_time_vs_manual_baseline.interpretation: Positive lead cycles mean the system saw the topic before its volume crossed the threshold a human would have noticed. Negative lead cycles mean the threshold was crossed first.

false_positives.note: A 'false positive' here means the topic did not double its own trailing volume within the window. That is not proof it was noise - it may simply be a slower topic, and the window is short. Treat this as an upper bound, not a precision score.

permutation_test.interpretation: The detector flags topics in the real ordering that the shuffled corpus never produces, so the signal is not an artefact of the collection schedule.
